seed_note: All arrays float32 unless stated. Teacher computation: CPU, torch eval(), single thread.

model.training: PneumoniaMNIST train, first 256 images of each class in dataset order, x/255, batch 64 fixed order, Adam lr=0.003, 80 epochs, CE loss. Students do not retrain it.

D1.title_zh: 這張 CAM 是怎麼畫出來的？

shapes.labels: int64 (8,), ground-truth class of each input (0 normal, 1 pneumonia)

D1.public_settings: The CAM is built from the 16x14x14 feature map of cnn.pt and the fc weights, then rendered at 28x28. Candidate design choices to search (the teacher made one choice for each): target class {0, 1, predicted class per image}; fc bias {included, excluded}; negative-value handling {none, ReLU, abs}; per-image normalization {divide by max, min-max}; order {normalize then resize, resize then normalize}; resize {bilinear align_corners=False, bilinear align_corners=True, nearest, bicubic}. D1_preview.png is display only.
D1.metric: per image: MAE and SSIM (skimage structural_similarity, data_range=1) against target
D1.threshold: every image MAE <= 0.003 and SSIM >= 0.98 (also on held-out images)
D1.deliverable: python function reproduce_D1(inputs: np.ndarray (N,28,28)) -> np.ndarray (N,28,28), plus report: inferred recipe, at least two hypotheses compared, predicted-class CAM vs fixed-class CAM, why CAM does not prove lesion localization

shapes.features: (64,16) float32 = TeacherCNN GAP features (mean of features(x) over H,W) of 64 training images, 32 per class
shapes.loss.csv: 21 rows: step 0 = loss before any update, step k = loss after the k-th update

D2.public_settings: Only the linear head nn.Linear(16,2) is trained; the CNN is frozen (features already given). Every step uses the same full batch of 64 samples. Loss family: cross-entropy, possibly class-weighted with weight ratio class1:class0 in {1,2,3,4} (PyTorch nn.CrossEntropyLoss(weight=...) convention). Optimizer family: torch.optim.SGD, weight_decay=0, lr in [0.01, 0.20] step 0.01, momentum in [0.0, 0.9] step 0.1, momentum buffer starts at zero. Number of updates = 20.
D2.metric: RMSE between your 21-point loss curve and D2_loss.csv; max |weight/bias difference| between your final head and D2_head_final.pt
D2.threshold: curve RMSE <= 1e-4 and max abs parameter error <= 1e-3 (also on a held-out set with different features and a different head_init)
D2.deliverable: python function reproduce_D2(features, labels, head_init_state_dict) -> (final_state_dict, losses[21]), plus report: inferred recipe and at least two hypotheses whose loss curves are close but whose final weights differ
